query: Need a nice soy candle for my mom's birthday, lavender scent, gift wrapped, under $30.

products.title: Vrbgify Lavender Scented Candle
products.description: Bring tranquility and elegance into your home with this 7.5 oz highly scented lavender candle, expertly crafted from natural soy wax and featuring a 6 percent essential oil concentration for a rich, long-lasting fragrance. Housed in a sophisticated purple glass jar, this candle delivers over 40 hours of clean, even burn thanks to its lead-free cotton wick. The residue-free formula is free from paraffin and chemical additives, and the elegant jar can be repurposed as a decorative vase or storage container after use.
key_features: 6 percent essential oil concentration for a rich, long-lasting fragrance
Made from natural soy wax, free from paraffin and chemical residuals
Over 40 hours of clean, even burn with a lead-free cotton wick
Reusable purple glass jar can be repurposed as a vase or storage container

products.title: Lavender Soy Candle
products.description: This extra large 35oz lavender scented candle is designed for a soothing ambiance with three lead-free cotton wicks that ensure an even burn for up to 150 hours. Crafted from a premium blend of natural soy and renewable palm wax, it provides a cleaner, slower burn and a stronger scent throw. The candle comes in an elegant jar featuring a purple and pink floral pattern with a gold accent, packaged in a stylish gift box making it an ideal present for various occasions.
key_features: Blend of natural soy and renewable palm wax
Elegant floral-patterned jar with gold accent

products.title: Lavender Scented Soy Votive Candle
products.description: This charming lavender-scented soy votive candle is hand-poured into a white glass jar and topped with a natural wooden lid. Infused with a special soy blend wax and pure lavender essential oil, it provides a soothingly soft aroma perfect for small spaces or relaxing baths. Each 2-ounce candle comes elegantly packaged with a lavender ribbon and bow, making it an ideal gift choice.
key_features: Decorated with a lavender ribbon and bow

products.title: Scented Soy Candle
products.description: A high-quality soy wax candle from Mrs. Meyer's Clean Day, featuring the relaxing and soothing scent of lavender. This candle offers a substantial 35-hour burn time, making it ideal for long-lasting home fragrance. Mrs. Meyer's commitment to cruelty-free practices is noted, as this product is not tested on animals. It comes in a reusable glass jar with a black lid.

products.title: Lavender Scented Soy Wax Candle, 10oz
products.description: A playful and thoughtful gift candle designed for parents, featuring a humorous message on the label: 'BEING YOUR FAVORITE CHILD SEEMS LIKE GIFT ENOUGH... BUT HERE'S A CANDLE'. The candle is hand-poured using pure soy wax with a lead-free cotton wick for a clean burn and is housed in an elegant amber glass jar with a gold lid. It is scented with calming lavender to promote relaxation and serenity.
key_features: Encased in an elegant amber jar

products.title: Lavender & Vanilla Soy Candle
products.description: A soothing 12.3 oz soy candle featuring a calming lavender and vanilla fragrance blend. Infused with lavender essential oil for relaxation and balanced with fir needles and tonka bean for a warm, inviting scent. Packaged in a plastic-free glass jar with an acacia wood lid, designed for repurposing after the candle is finished. Includes a 3-wick option and is available in 12.3 oz size. Ideal for creating a tranquil ambiance in living spaces.
key_features: Plastic-free glass jar with acacia wood lid
Upcycle-ready jar for storage after use
Calming blend of lavender, vanilla, fir, and tonka bean
Made with soy wax and essential oils
Reusable jar suitable for storage after use
12.3 oz size with option to choose 3.5 oz
Therapeutic lavender essential oil for relaxation
Glass jar is reusable after candle is gone

products.title: Soy Candle
products.description: Part of The Seasonal Edit by Unplug Soy Candles, this minimalist soy candle features a calming blend of lavender, sage, and mint. Housed in a clean glass jar with a delicate square label, it is crafted from 100% pure soy wax with a cotton-braided wick, providing a clean burn for up to 80 hours.
key_features: Scented with lavender, sage, and mint

products.title: Soy Glass Jar Candle
products.description: Enjoy the calming, garden-inspired aroma of this Mrs. Meyer's Lavender Soy Candle. Crafted with a vegetable soy wax base and scented with natural essential oils, this candle provides up to 25 hours of clean, aromatic burn time. The product is proudly vegan and cruelty-free, tested by people, not animals. Once the candle has fully burned, the glass jar is designed to be reused, promoting sustainability.
key_features: Vegan and cruelty-free (tested by people, not animals)
